metadata.title: Corporate Learning and Skills Deployment Model
metadata.description: Proposed logical runtime and browser delivery surfaces. No Studytube cloud provider, deployment region, account topology or separately priced SKU is asserted. Shared underlying services may support several offers; optional features remain governed by tenant entitlement and contracts. MVP: a bounded employer academy, workforce reconciliation, one qualification cohort and one reviewed course; add skill assessments and DOI only when configured and accepted.
